annotations.title: Tailor résumé and write cover letter in one call

description: Generate both the tailored résumé and the cover letter for one job in a single call (tailor_resume and write_cover_letter do one each). Give exactly one of job_id, application_id, or job_description with company and role (job pages are not fetched here). Returns the tailored résumé with its changes and PDF link, and the cover letter, each with its quality check and the writing allowance after both. An AI model writes both (Anthropic's Claude, with DeepSeek through OpenRouter as the fallback). It uses the candidate's monthly writing allowance for both. When one fails, the other still comes back and errors names the one that failed. Show the candidate both before they go anywhere.

include_resume_file.description: Link the résumé as a PDF. Default true.

instruction.description: The candidate's steer for the cover letter.

intensity.description: keywords: only surface the posting terms; rewrite (default): reword bullets toward the role.

job_description.description: The posting's text, for a job outside the catalog.

job_id.description: An id from search_jobs or recommend_jobs.

keywords.description: Terms from the posting the candidate wants on the résumé.
